scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.android:debug: npm run build && npx cap sync android && cd android && JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk} GRADLE_USER_HOME=${GRADLE_USER_HOME:-/private/tmp/arrow-gradle-cache} ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:open: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:open: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
